contentBlocks.text: SASSA Cash Send Guide — Collect Your Grant in Cash

Cash Send is SASSA's cash collection service for beneficiaries who do not have a bank account or prefer to collect their grant in cash. Instead of depositing money into a bank account, SASSA sends you an SMS voucher that you take to any participating retailer to receive your cash.

steps.title: Your grant is approved
steps.description: SASSA approves your grant for the month. Your status shows 'Approved' on the portal.

steps.title: Payment is processed
steps.description: Between the 25th and 30th, SASSA processes the payment and sends the funds to the Cash Send system.

steps.title: You receive an SMS voucher
steps.description: An SMS is sent to your phone with a unique collection voucher code. This SMS is your ticket to collect cash.

steps.title: Visit any participating retailer
steps.description: Take your phone (showing the SMS) and your original ID to any participating store.

steps.title: Collect your cash
steps.description: The cashier verifies your ID and voucher code, then hands you your grant in cash.

contentBlocks.text: You can collect your SASSA Cash Send at any branch of these retailers nationwide:

contentBlocks.title: No Purchase Necessary
contentBlocks.text: You do not need to buy anything to collect your grant. The cashier will hand you your money without requiring a purchase.
How to Switch from Bank Transfer to Cash Send
If you are currently receiving your grant via bank transfer but want to switch to Cash Send:

steps.title: Log into the SRD portal
steps.description: Go to srd.sassa.gov.za and log in with your ID and phone number.

steps.title: Go to Payment Method
steps.description: Navigate to the payment method section on your dashboard.

steps.title: Select Cash Send
steps.description: Choose Cash Send as your payment method.

steps.title: Confirm the change
steps.description: The change takes effect from the following month. Do not switch mid-month if you have a pending payment.

faqs.question: How long does it take to receive the Cash Send SMS?
faqs.answer: The SMS voucher is typically sent within 24 to 48 hours after SASSA processes the payment (between the 25th and 30th).

faqs.question: What if I lose the SMS or delete it by accident?
faqs.answer: Contact SASSA to request a resend. You can also visit a SASSA office with your ID to get a replacement voucher code.

faqs.question: Does the SMS voucher expire?
faqs.answer: Yes. The voucher expires within 7 to 10 days. Collect your grant as soon as you receive the SMS.

faqs.question: Can someone else collect my grant using my SMS?
faqs.answer: No. The retailer will verify your ID before releasing funds. Only the registered beneficiary can collect.

faqs.question: What if I do not receive the SMS at all?
faqs.answer: First check that your phone has network coverage and enough storage. If you still do not receive it, check your status on the portal — your payment method may still be set to bank transfer.
